title: 晶圓臨界尺寸電子顯微量測
summary: 從灰階到邊緣、電子劑量到尺寸報告：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Grayscale to edge and Electron dose to Dimension report: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 灰階到邊緣 → 低能電子
stages.titleEn: Grayscale to edge to Low-energy electrons
stages.description: 把「灰階到邊緣」「像素校正」「低能電子」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Grayscale to edge, Pixel calibration, Low-energy electrons.

steps.title: 灰階到邊緣：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Grayscale to edge: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「影像邊緣位置取決於訊號及定義」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Image-edge position depends on signal and definition.
steps.instruction: 畫跨越兩邊的線掃描灰階，標出候選邊緣演算法。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a line-scan grayscale profile and mark candidate edge algorithms. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 影像邊緣位置取決於訊號及定義；邊緣閾值改變會造成系統性 CD 偏差。
steps.observationEn: Image-edge position depends on signal and definition; Edge-threshold changes cause systematic CD bias.
steps.failure: 若採用「最亮像素永遠就是實體邊界」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming the brightest pixel is always the physical edge", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「灰階到邊緣」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：影像邊緣位置取決於訊號及定義。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Grayscale to edge diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Image-edge position depends on signal and definition.

knowledge.titleEn: Grayscale to edge / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「最亮像素永遠就是實體邊界」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Assuming the brightest pixel is always the physical edge.

quiz.question: 關於「灰階到邊緣」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Grayscale to edge, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 影像邊緣位置取決於訊號及定義
最亮像素永遠就是實體邊界
將放大倍率當成可追溯校正
optionsEn: Image-edge position depends on signal and definition
Assuming the brightest pixel is always the physical edge
quiz.explanation: 影像邊緣位置取決於訊號及定義；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Image-edge position depends on signal and definition. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 灰階到邊緣：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grayscale to edge: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「最亮像素永遠就是實體邊界」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Assuming the brightest pixel is always the physical edge.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「灰階到邊緣」成果，先指出錯誤主張「最亮像素永遠就是實體邊界」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：邊緣閾值改變會造成系統性 CD 偏差。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Grayscale to edge artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Assuming the brightest pixel is always the physical edge". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Edge-threshold changes cause systematic CD bias. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 影像邊緣位置取決於訊號及定義；邊緣閾值改變會造成系統性 CD 偏差。
steps.observationEn: Image-edge position depends on signal and definition; Edge-threshold changes cause systematic CD bias.
steps.failure: 若採用「最亮像素永遠就是實體邊界」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Assuming the brightest pixel is always the physical edge", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「灰階到邊緣」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「邊緣閾值改變會造成系統性 CD 偏差」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Grayscale to edge, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Edge-threshold changes cause systematic CD bias" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 灰階到邊緣／物理與模型
knowledge.titleEn: Grayscale to edge / Physics and model
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：邊緣閾值改變會造成系統性 CD 偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Edge-threshold changes cause systematic CD bias.

knowledge.title: 灰階到邊緣／驗證與限制
knowledge.titleEn: Grayscale to edge / Verification and limits
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「最亮像素永遠就是實體邊界」與「影像邊緣位置取決於訊號及定義」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。

steps.title: 像素校正：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「放大影像不會自動提高尺度準確度」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Magnification does not automatically improve scale accuracy.
steps.instruction:
以假設標準節距換算 nm/pixel 並標示校正不確定度。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設校正標準的 100 nm 節距在影像上占 40 pixel，比例為 2.5 nm/pixel；量得線寬 20 pixel，名目 CD=50 nm。若線寬抽取本身的不確定度為 1 pixel，單此項即 2.5 nm，尚未合併校正與邊緣模型誤差；不能把像素尺寸當成完整準確度。
steps.instructionEn:
Calibrate nm/pixel with a hypothetical pitch standard and uncertainty. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume a calibrated 100 nm pitch spans 40 pixels, giving 2.5 nm/pixel. A 20-pixel width has nominal CD=50 nm. If width extraction alone has 1-pixel uncertainty, that contribution is 2.5 nm before calibration and edge-model errors are combined. Pixel scale is not complete accuracy.
steps.observation: 放大影像不會自動提高尺度準確度；標準件本身也帶有不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Magnification does not automatically improve scale accuracy; Reference standards themselves have uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若採用「將放大倍率當成可追溯校正」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating magnification as traceable calibration", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「像素校正」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：放大影像不會自動提高尺度準確度。
算例驗收：驗算 2.5 nm/pixel、50 nm 與 2.5 nm 誤差項，寫清 1 pixel 指線寬而不是每一側邊緣。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Pixel calibration diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Magnification does not automatically improve scale accuracy.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify scale, 50 nm width and the 2.5 nm contribution; state that one pixel refers to width, not independently to each edge.
